title: Meet Archana
photoAlt: Archana on stage in a green and magenta silk saree
paragraphs: Archana is an engineer by training. She thinks in systems. She also thinks in stories.
That combination is rare. It is also the reason this website exists.
Watch her at our Golu and you will see it. She stands by the steps and walks a room full of kids through Krishna dancing on a five-hooded serpent. Then the adults start asking questions too.
She is a mom, a wife, a daughter and a sister. She is a teacher, a reader, a writer and a storyteller. She cooks. She makes art. On any given day she wears more hats than our Golu has steps.

Her 2012 blog says I started this tradition in our home. That is true. More importantly, she is the reason it kept going. Since 2005, hundreds of people have walked through our door to sing, dress up and celebrate. She made every one of them feel at home.
The words on this site are hers. The blog. The story beside every doll. I just set up the steps.
closing: Nine nights. Many hats. One Archana.
